picks.competition: India tour of New Zealand 2026-27, 3rd T20I
picks.selection: India to win the match
picks.text: India travel to Wellington holding a 2-0 lead in this five-match T20I series and needing one more win to take it with two games still to spare. They levelled the Christchurch double-header by four wickets on 24 October after the opening match at Hagley Oval, and the third T20I at Hnry Stadium is the last of three straight meetings before the tour moves to Eden Park on 30 October and Seddon Park on 1 November. New Zealand have lost both completed matches and have not been able to defend a total against India in this series. Thirty-five of the 49 tips posted on OLBG sit with the visitors, the deepest consensus anywhere on the cricket board, and we back India on the match-winner line.

picks.selection: Ireland to win the match
picks.text: This five-match series is level at one apiece and the third ODI decides who carries the lead into the back end of the tour. Ireland took the opener by 55 runs, bowling Namibia out for 174 in 37.5 overs after Harry Stirling's 56 from 71 balls and Josh Hoey's 3-29. Namibia hit back two days later with a 31-run win built on Gerhard Erasmus carrying his bat for an unbeaten 156 from 125 deliveries, a personal best that beat his previous 125, and Jan Frylinck's 76 from 90. Ireland's chase stalled at 290 in 47.3 overs despite Stirling's 77 from 71 and Hoey's second three-wicket haul of the series. Stirling has made 56 and 77 in the two completed games, so the Irish top order is in form even in defeat, and 22 of the 32 tips stay with them.

picks.selection: Pakistan to win the match
picks.text: Pakistan are three wins from three in this tri-series and have already beaten Sri Lanka inside it. In the Rawalpindi opener on 18 October they posted 305 and won by 37 runs, Salman Agha making 107 from 90 balls for his fourth ODI hundred while Shaheen Shah Afridi took 3-55 to bowl Sri Lanka out for 268 in 48.1 overs. Sri Lanka's only win of the tournament came against England by two wickets on 22 October. Pakistan then beat England by 87 runs and, at this same ground on 25 October, chased 242 to win by one wicket with 17 balls remaining. A side winning that close a game at home is not one to fade, and 22 of the 31 tips are with the hosts.
sources: ESPNcricinfo - Pakistan v Sri Lanka, 1st match report

picks.selection: Afghanistan to win the match
picks.text: Afghanistan have beaten Zimbabwe twice in eight days and won the UAE ODI Tri-Series doing it, so they arrive at Sharjah with the shortest form line in international cricket this week. They took the group match by 158 runs, 294 against 136 in 38.4 overs, then won the final at this ground on 23 October by seven wickets with 93 balls unused: Zimbabwe 169, Afghanistan 170-3 in 34.3 overs, Ibrahim Zadran 70 not out and Rahmat Shah 43. Rashid Khan took three wickets in that final and eleven across the tournament to be named player of the series, while Sikandar Raza's 68 was the only real Zimbabwe resistance. The tri-series table read Afghanistan two wins from two at +2.362 net run rate, Zimbabwe one and one at -0.590. We back Afghanistan, but at -450 the price sits outside the -250 to +10000 band we hold top-grade picks to, so this is one rung down.
